name: Default Agent Edit Unlock
description: Unlocks the two edit buttons (agent card + detail drawer) that the QwenPaw console hard-disables for the built-in default agent. Frontend-only: at startup, rewrites disabled:s.id==="default" to disabled:!1 in assets/AgentGallery-*.js, backs up the originals (.js/.gz/.br + index.html), and cache-busts patched chunks via content-hash query strings plus an injected import map, so a normal refresh picks up the change. Pin/drag/toggle/delete guards stay intact (they mirror backend guards). Idempotent and self-healing across pip upgrades and container rebuilds; uninstall restores every file byte-for-byte. Kill switch: QWENPAW_DEFAULT_EDIT_UNLOCK=0. Verified against qwenpaw 2.3.0; anchors on the common.edit i18n key and skips with a warning if a future bundle changes shape.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 解锁 QwenPaw 控制台对内置默认智能体写死禁用的两处编辑按钮（卡片 + 详情抽屉）。纯前端补丁：启动时把 assets/AgentGallery-*.js 里的 disabled:s.id==="default" 改为 disabled:!1，备份原版（.js/.gz/.br + index.html），用内容哈希 query + import map 做缓存爆破，普通刷新即生效。置顶/拖拽/启停/删除的锁定原样保留。幂等自愈，pip 升级、容器重建后自动重打；卸载逐字节还原。关闭开关：QWENPAW_DEFAULT_EDIT_UNLOCK=0。在 qwenpaw 2.3.0 实测；锚定 common.edit i18n key，未来 bundle 变形时打 warning 并跳过。
